answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to complete a unique, non-parallelizable computational proof before it earns rights: the network issues a fresh puzzle tied to that identity's public key, solvable only by sequential work that takes a glacier-slow, fixed minimum time and cannot be outsourced in bulk. Only identities that did the work reach the violet-marked oasis; a second identity means a second full puzzle and wait. Forging a thousand fakes then costs a thousand sequential waits plus power, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its rights.
